name: Katakoi Contrast -way of parting-
original_name: 片恋いコントラスト ―way of parting―
source:
Part of "triAngle PROJECT," a collaboration project between Otomate and Frontier Works. Each series will have 3 games released in span of 9 months for Windows under the same concept: one heroine, two heroes, and triangle love.

Katakoi Contrast -Way of Parting- theme is school x pure love x triangle love
translation:
属于Otomate和Frontier Works之间的合作项目“triAngle PROJECT”的一部分。每个系列将在9个月内推出3款Windows游戏，其概念相同：一位女主角、两位英雄和三角爱情。

Katakoi对比-离别之道-主题是学校x纯爱x三角爱
